title: 第193章开始搞基建了第192章采矿
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
第193章开始搞基建了
原本仙兽们拿到修元丹，还有茫然。
不明白这个小东西究竟有什么用处？是给他们吃的吗？
可他们有的是食肉的啊！
郁凡给他们介绍了修元丹的妙用，仙兽们半信半疑，但得到了老者和蛇赢的肯定，尝试着将修元丹放入了嘴里。
随即便感到修为瞬间增长了一截。
当然这是对于低修为的仙兽们而言。
高阶仙兽所领取的则是破障丹。
不少高阶仙兽都感受到了自己修为境界似乎有所突破。
仙兽们眼睛一亮，切实的感受到了仙丹的好处。
他们从来没有想过，原来修为真的是可以借助外物来提升的。
目光落在郁凡的身上，人类果然厉害，能够炼制出如此厉害的仙丹。
若是他能够多炼制一点，他们愿意多打上一段时间的工。
真的，他们一点也不介意做一个打工仔。
修元丹和破障丹都是基础丹药，比较容易制作出来。
但对于那两个已经成为了仙君级别的仙兽而言，这些基础丹药就没有什么用了。
郁凡也很明确的将自己目前暂时只研究出了少部分丹药状态告诉了两位前辈。
两位前辈摆了摆手，也不着急。
“我们都在这里待了这么多年了，修为一直在仙君境界未曾突破过，已经习惯了。”
“如今的我们不老不死也等得。”

蛇赢大方的拍了拍羽凡的肩膀，说道：“小兄弟放心，我们相信你。”
既然两位前辈不介意郁凡慢慢的去研究这些仙草的搭配使用，那郁凡更是不用着急了。
他一边琢磨着，一边有条不紊的在红色土地上开始搭建建筑。
想要改变仙界，自然是要改变它目前的一片空白。
无非就是搞基建嘛。
这个对于华国人来说最擅长了。
随意的搭建了一个木房子后，郁凡便开始在红色土地上开荒种田了。
他很想知道这种红土地是否真的能够种出东西来。
如果可以，那么它与普通的土地的区别到底是什么呢？
郁凡早就对这片红土地好奇已久了。
据他所知，上神虽然踢翻了炼丹炉造成了这里山脉的灼烧。
可这片红土地可是早在踢翻炼丹炉之前便有了。
仙界的气候没有特殊原因，其实是毫无变化的，也不存在着气候环境影响土质不同。
曾经拼死拼活得来的金色种子，也移植到了这边的小屋旁。
郁凡又从森林里搜刮了不少的无人问津的药草们，将其移植到红土地中。
因为仙气的缘故，郁凡也没有想过这些植物是否需要浇水之类的。
本就是试验品，郁凡事情也多，没有将精力都放置在这些上面。
谁知道过了几天后，郁凡才发现原本光秃秃的土地上已经长满了各色的植物。
看上去倒是郁郁葱葱一片。
让郁凡都不得不感叹这些草药的生命力顽强。

若是在人界，这些草药没有精心伺候哪有长得这么好的。
郁凡想了想，又在另外的一片普通的土地上种植了一些草药。
content_en:
Chapter 193: Infrastructure construction begins
Originally, the immortal beasts were at a loss after receiving the Xiuyuan Pill.
I don’t understand what the use of this little thing is? Is it for them to eat?
But some of them are carnivores!
Yu Fan introduced them to the magical effects of the Xiu Yuan Pill. The immortal beasts were dubious, but after receiving approval from the old man and Snake Ying, they tried to put the Xiu Yuan Pill into their mouths.
Immediately, I felt that my cultivation level had increased instantly.
Of course, this is for the fairy beasts with low cultivation level.
What high-level immortal beasts receive is the barrier-breaking pill.
Many high-level immortal beasts feel that their cultivation realm seems to have made a breakthrough.
The eyes of the immortal beasts lit up, and they truly felt the benefits of the elixir.
They have never thought that cultivation can really be improved with the help of external objects.
His eyes fell on Yu Fan. Humans were really powerful and could refine such a powerful elixir.
If he could refine it more, they would be willing to work for a while longer.
Really, they don't mind being a wage earner at all.
The Yuan Xiu Dan and the Barrier Breaking Dan are both basic elixirs and are relatively easy to make.
But for the two immortal beasts that have become immortal kings, these basic elixirs are of little use.
Yu Fan also clearly told the two seniors that he had only developed a small number of elixirs for the time being.
The two seniors waved their hands and were not in a hurry.
"We have been here for so many years, and our cultivation has never broken through the realm of the Immortal Lord, so we are used to it."
"Now we can wait even if we don't grow old or die."
She Ying patted Yu Fan's shoulder generously and said, "Don't worry, little brother, we believe in you."
Since the two seniors don't mind Yu Fan taking his time to study the combination and use of these immortal herbs, then Yu Fan doesn't need to worry.
While he was thinking about it, he began to build buildings on the red soil in an orderly manner.
If you want to change the fairy world, you must naturally change its current blank state.
It’s nothing more than infrastructure construction.
This is what Chinese people are best at.
After building a wooden house at random, Yu Fan began to open up wasteland and farm on the red land.
He wanted to know if anything could actually be grown on this red soil.
If so, what is the difference between it and ordinary land?
Yu Fan has been curious about this red land for a long time.
As far as he knew, God kicked over the alchemy furnace and caused the mountains here to burn.
But this piece of red land existed long before the alchemy furnace was kicked over.
There is no special reason for the climate in the fairy world. In fact, it does not change. There is no difference in soil quality due to the influence of climate and environment.
The golden seeds that had been obtained through hard work were also transplanted to the hut here.
Yu Fan also collected a lot of unknown medicinal herbs from the forest and transplanted them into the red soil.
Because of his immortal energy, Yu Fan never thought about whether these plants needed watering.
He was originally a test subject, and Yu Fan had many things to do, so he didn't put all his energy into them.
Unexpectedly, a few days later, Yu Fan discovered that the originally bare land was already covered with various plants.
It looks quite lush.
Yu Fan couldn't help but sigh at the tenacious vitality of these herbs.
If it were in the human world, how could these herbs grow so well if they were not taken care of carefully?
Yu Fan thought for a while and planted some herbs on another piece of ordinary land.
